spans.s:
भेल भेल, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. rt. 1. भी), timid,
timorous, fearful; foolish, ignorant, unwise, simple-
minded; tall; active, agile; unsteady (literally or
figuratively), inconstant; (अस्), m. a boat, skiff, float,
raft; N. of a Ṛṣi (supposed to be the author of
some medical works, cf. भेड).
भेलक, अस्, अम्, m. n. = भेल, a boat, raft.
भेलु भेलु, a particular high number.

भेलूपुरा भेलूपुरा, f., N. of a suburb of
Benares.
